blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Converge has brought back Serbian coach Djordje Jovicic in an active capacity to help out the team’s campaign in the PBA Governors’ Cup, which resumes next week. Jovicic was spotted calling the shots for the FiberXers during Thursday’s 113-99 loss to the Blackwater Bossing in a tune-up game held at Ronac Art Center in San Juan. Team governor Archen Cayabyab is hoping that Jovicic’s expertise will replicate what Converge did in the Philippine Cup when she served as a consultant under coach Delta Pineda’s staff. “He is really in charge of our defense, and when he was with us, the […]...
